description: Initial enemy guide copy. Explicit saves in the Units editor own subsequent wording.

90001.en: Closes in and strikes one nearby target in melee.
90001.zh: 接近目标后，以近战攻击单个敌人。

90002.en: A durable close-combat fighter that strikes nearby targets.
90002.zh: 耐久的近战战士，攻击身边的目标。

90003.en: Attacks a single target from range with a projectile.
90003.zh: 从远处发射投射物，攻击单个目标。

90004.en: A fast-moving melee attacker that closes the distance before striking.
90004.zh: 移动迅速的近战进攻者，接近目标后发动攻击。

90005.en: Launches a heavy ranged projectile at one target, with a long pause between attacks.
90005.zh: 向单个目标发射重型远程投射物，两次攻击之间的间隔较长。

90006.en: Supports nearby monsters with a temporary attack-speed boost instead of dealing direct damage.
90006.zh: 为附近的怪物提供临时攻速提升，不直接造成伤害。

90007.en: Strikes a nearby target and deals splash damage to additional targets around the impact.
90007.zh: 攻击附近的目标，并对落点周围的其他目标造成溅射伤害。

90008.en: Moves through obstacles and fires homing projectiles at targets within range.
90008.zh: 可穿过障碍，向射程内的目标发射追踪投射物。

90009.en: Restores the health of nearby monsters instead of dealing direct damage.
90009.zh: 恢复附近怪物的生命值，不直接造成伤害。

90010.en: The first form of a transforming monster. It strikes in melee before changing into its next form during battle.
90010.zh: 变形怪物的第一形态，以近战攻击，并在战斗中转为下一形态。

90011.en: The second form of a transforming monster. It attacks in melee and can change into its final form.
90011.zh: 变形怪物的第二形态，以近战攻击，并可转为最终形态。

90012.en: The final form of a transforming monster, combining melee strikes with periodic attacks against several nearby targets.
90012.zh: 变形怪物的最终形态，既能近战攻击，也会定期攻击附近的多个目标。

91001.en: A fence-side prowler that treats the frontier grasslands as its private hunting ground.
91001.zh: 这位篱笆旁的潜行客，把边境草原当成了自己的私家猎场。

91002.en: This restless stray follows old cart tracks wherever they wind across the plains.
91002.zh: 这只闲不住的流浪犬，循着旧车辙走遍了平原。

91003.en: A flash of russet among the meadow stones, always curious about an unattended camp.
91003.zh: 草甸乱石间闪过一抹赤褐色，它总对无人看守的营地充满好奇。

91004.en: Deep forest hollows are home to this shaggy wanderer and its muddy pawprints.
91004.zh: 这位毛茸茸的漫游者住在密林深处，沿途留下沾泥的脚印。

91005.en: A pale shape from the snowfields, familiar with every ridge of the winter landscape.
91005.zh: 来自雪原的苍白身影，熟悉冬日大地上的每一道山脊。

91006.en: Its crimson shell brings a startling splash of color to the sun-baked desert.
91006.zh: 赤红的甲壳，为烈日烘烤的荒漠添上了一抹醒目的颜色。

91007.en: Frost-colored plates make this beetle look like a shard of the northern glaciers.
91007.zh: 冰霜色的甲片，让这只甲虫仿佛成了北方冰川的一块碎片。

91008.en: Travelers once mistook its metallic shell for a relic half-buried in the sand.
91008.zh: 旅人曾把它金属般的甲壳，当成半埋在沙里的古老遗物。

91009.en: The forest floor is full of secrets, and this red-shelled scavenger inspects them all.
91009.zh: 林地上藏着无数秘密，这位红甲拾荒者总要逐一探个究竟。

91010.en: A proud plains hunter, drawn to the open sky above the scattered grazing grounds.
91010.zh: 这位骄傲的平原猎手，钟爱散落牧场上方的开阔天空。

91011.en: Riverbank camps know this noisy visitor almost as well as they know the morning mist.
91011.zh: 河岸营地对这位吵闹的访客，就像对清晨薄雾一样熟悉。

91012.en: An old resident of the quiet forest, watching the paths long after dusk.
91012.zh: 寂静森林的老住客，在暮色降临许久后仍注视着林间小径。

91013.en: Its bright plumage is a colorful reminder of warmer groves beyond the open plains.
91013.zh: 鲜亮的羽毛，让人想起开阔平原之外那些温暖的林园。

91014.en: A red flicker over the grass, like a wandering ember that never found its campfire.
91014.zh: 草叶上掠过一道红影，仿佛找不到归属篝火的流浪余烬。

91015.en: The snow bird belongs to the still mornings when the whole north seems to hold its breath.
91015.zh: 雪鸟属于那些寂静的清晨，仿佛整个北境都屏住了呼吸。

91016.en: Its oversized beak has made it the subject of many a plains traveler's sketch.
91016.zh: 夸张的大喙，让它成了许多平原旅人速写本上的主角。

91017.en: A perpetually offended riverbank resident, unimpressed by every passerby.
91017.zh: 这位河岸住客总是一脸不悦，对每个过路人都不以为然。

91018.en: River folklore describes this rough-looking blowfish as a beast from the muddy shallows.
91018.zh: 河畔传说把这只粗犷的刺鲀，称作来自泥泞浅滩的野兽。

91019.en: Even the quietest meadow seems ready for a celebration when this colorful buffalo appears.
91019.zh: 只要这头色彩鲜明的野牛出现，再安静的草甸也像要开一场庆典。

91020.en: A familiar silhouette on the plains, following trails older than the frontier settlements.
91020.zh: 平原上熟悉的身影，沿着比边境村落更古老的兽径漫游。

91021.en: Its iron-like shell recalls the broken tools scattered around abandoned desert mines.
91021.zh: 铁一般的甲壳，让人想起废弃沙漠矿场里散落的旧工具。

91022.en: Among the desert stones, this crab looks like another boulder that decided to wander.
91022.zh: 在荒漠乱石间，它像一块突然决定四处游荡的石头。

91023.en: A pale wanderer of the icy banks, carrying a little piece of winter wherever it goes.
91023.zh: 冰岸边的苍白漫游者，无论走到哪里都带着几分冬日气息。

91024.en: Plains shepherds know this goat by its stubborn temper and untidy wandering routes.
91024.zh: 平原牧人都认得这只山羊，认得它的倔脾气和毫无章法的漫游路线。

91025.en: A dark-coated figure often glimpsed between the trunks of the silent forest.
91025.zh: 沉寂森林的树干之间，时常能瞥见它深色的身影。

91026.en: Some say the mushroom groves simply grew tired of standing still and sent out this goat.
91026.zh: 有人说，蘑菇林厌倦了原地不动，于是派出了这只山羊。

91027.en: A riverbank oddity whose helmet has inspired more questions than any traveler can answer.
91027.zh: 这位河岸怪客的头盔，引出了无数旅人也答不上的问题。

91028.en: The shallows have many strange residents, but few wear such a permanently wild expression.
91028.zh: 浅滩住着许多怪异生灵，却很少有谁像它这样始终神情狂放。

91029.en: A drifting curiosity that looks more at home in an ancient forest dream than in a field guide.
91029.zh: 飘游的奇异生灵，比起野外图鉴，更像来自古老森林的一场梦。

91030.en: Its glassy winter colors recall the blue light beneath a frozen lake.
91030.zh: 通透的冬日色泽，令人想起冰封湖面下的幽蓝光芒。

91031.en: The desert's glowing sunsets seem to have lent this lizard their fiery colors.
91031.zh: 荒漠灿烂的落日，仿佛把火焰般的颜色借给了这只蜥蜴。

91032.en: Its striking horn makes even a small desert trail feel like the entrance to an old legend.
91032.zh: 醒目的尖角，让一条小小的沙漠兽径也像通向古老传说的入口。

91033.en: A curious forest lizard whose unusual silhouette has puzzled generations of scouts.
91033.zh: 这只轮廓奇特的林中蜥蜴，让一代又一代斥候困惑不已。

91034.en: A strange visitor in winter colors, like a tale carried inland from the frozen coast.
91034.zh: 披着冬日色彩的奇异访客，仿佛是从冰封海岸传入内陆的一则故事。

91035.en: A river wanderer dressed for adventures far beyond the shadowed forest banks.
91035.zh: 这位河流漫游者的一身装束，像是准备去阴影林岸之外闯荡远方。

91036.en: Its vivid rings are a favorite subject of naturalists studying the forest waterways.
91036.zh: 鲜明的环纹，是研究森林水道的博物学家最喜爱的题材之一。

91037.en: A small green mystery, leaving frontier travelers to argue about what a slime really is.
91037.zh: 一团小小的绿色谜团，让边境旅人争论起史莱姆究竟是什么。

91038.en: Its rich purple hue stands out among the gold and green of the plains.
91038.zh: 浓郁的紫色，在平原的金黄与翠绿之间格外醒目。

91039.en: The blue shell looks like a polished keepsake from a winter stream.
91039.zh: 蓝色的壳，像是从冬日溪流里拾来的温润珍藏。

91040.en: A traveler with a spiral shell, forever carrying a reminder of distant waters.
91040.zh: 背着螺旋外壳的旅者，始终带着一份对远方水域的记忆。

91041.en: Mossy paths and rain-dark leaves provide the perfect backdrop for this green forest resident.
91041.zh: 长苔的小径和雨后深色的树叶，是这位绿色林中住客最相衬的背景。

91042.en: Its bell-like adornment has given rise to stories about lost caravans in the desert.
91042.zh: 铃铛般的装饰，引出了许多关于荒漠失踪商队的故事。

91043.en: A ribbon of fiery color winding through a landscape of ochre sand and dark stone.
91043.zh: 一道火焰般的色彩，蜿蜒于赭色沙地与深色岩石之间。

91044.en: The forest undergrowth has a familiar green shape that seldom belongs to a branch.
91044.zh: 林下草丛中那道熟悉的绿色形状，往往并不是一根树枝。

91045.en: Mushroom collectors tell each other to count their baskets again after this snake passes.
91045.zh: 采蘑菇的人会互相提醒，这条蛇经过后，最好再数一遍篮子。

91046.en: A riverbank creature whose rugged appearance suits the old marsh tales of the rolling plains.
91046.zh: 粗犷的模样，与起伏平原上那些古老的沼泽传说十分相衬。

91047.en: Its towering outline has inspired stories about wandering fortresses on the far plains.
91047.zh: 高耸的轮廓，催生了远方平原上流浪堡垒的种种传说。

91048.en: Its volcanic colors recall the dark ridges beyond the blazing desert.
91048.zh: 火山般的色彩，让人想起炽热荒漠之外那些深色山脊。

91049.en: A wolf from the darker plains legends, where every distant howl becomes a story.
91049.zh: 来自平原暗色传说的狼，在那里，每一声远处的长嗥都会成为故事。

91050.en: A familiar gray shadow on the frontier, woven into the oldest stories of the grasslands.
91050.zh: 边境上熟悉的灰色身影，早已融入草原最古老的故事。

91051.en: An enigmatic desert visitor whose crimson appearance recalls forgotten evening courts.
91051.zh: 神秘的荒漠访客，绯红的身影令人想起被遗忘的暮色宫廷。

91052.en: A wandering scholar of the barren places, tracing imaginary constellations in the desert dust.
91052.zh: 荒芜之地的流浪学者，在沙尘中描画想象中的星座。

91053.en: A familiar presence in the honey-scented clearings of the verdant forest.
91053.zh: 在翠绿森林中那些弥漫蜜香的空地上，总能见到它的身影。

91054.en: Its unusual appearance has kept the forest's curious children debating for years.
91054.zh: 奇特的模样，让森林里好奇的孩子们争论了许多年。

91055.en: A tireless-looking little resident of the paths beneath the frontier grass.
91055.zh: 边境草叶下的小径旁，住着这位看上去永远闲不住的小居民。

91056.en: Its sandy yellow colors blend into the long tracks between desert stones.
91056.zh: 沙黄色的身影，融入了荒漠石块之间绵长的路径。

91057.en: A creature of the shadow forest's caves, where old roots vanish into the dark.
91057.zh: 阴影森林洞穴中的生灵，古老树根在它身旁伸入黑暗。

91058.en: Its peculiar snout has made this bat the subject of more jokes than ghost stories.
91058.zh: 奇特的鼻吻，让这只蝙蝠成为笑话主角的次数，比成为鬼故事主角还多。

91059.en: Snowfield storytellers call its pale markings the signature of a forgotten winter.
91059.zh: 雪原上的说书人，把它苍白的纹样称作被遗忘寒冬留下的印记。

91060.en: Its devilish silhouette is a familiar detail in tales of the cursed desert outposts.
91060.zh: 恶魔般的轮廓，是那些诅咒荒漠哨站传说中的熟悉身影。

91061.en: The honey bee belongs to sunny forest clearings and the endless gossip of the flowers.
91061.zh: 蜜蜂属于阳光明媚的林间空地，也属于花朵们没完没了的闲谈。

91062.en: A sharp-lined wanderer of the dry lands, often sketched beside weathered desert maps.
91062.zh: 轮廓鲜明的旱地漫游者，常被画在风化泛旧的沙漠地图旁。

91063.en: Its round bud resembles a forgotten curiosity from a desert tinker's workshop.
91063.zh: 圆鼓鼓的花苞，像是沙漠工匠作坊里遗忘的一件奇妙造物。

91064.en: A fiery blossom of the dry lands, bright against the desert's blackened stones.
91064.zh: 旱地上一朵火焰般的花，在荒漠焦黑的岩石间分外明亮。

91065.en: A wandering bloom that seems to have strayed from the heart of a forest garden.
91065.zh: 一朵漫游的花，仿佛误走出了森林花园的深处。

91066.en: The desert's familiar green sentinel has acquired a life of its own.
91066.zh: 荒漠中那道熟悉的绿色守望身影，拥有了自己的生命。

91067.en: A curious meeting of desert shape and snowfield colors.
91067.zh: 沙漠的形状与雪原的色彩，在它身上奇妙地相遇。

91068.en: Its plated appearance recalls the old metalwork found in the desert ruins.
91068.zh: 甲片般的外观，令人想起沙漠遗迹中发现的古旧金属工艺。

91069.en: A mechanical-looking marvel that has left plains inventors arguing over its origins.
91069.zh: 宛如机械奇迹的外形，让平原发明家们争论起它的来历。

91070.en: A green flicker in the wide meadows, as familiar as the bending reeds.
91070.zh: 开阔草甸中一闪而过的绿色，像摇曳的芦苇一样令人熟悉。

91071.en: An elusive figure from the sunlit dust between the forest trees.
91071.zh: 一道若隐若现的身影，仿佛来自林木间阳光照亮的微尘。

91072.en: A little lantern-shaped wonder from the oldest paths of the ancient forest.
91072.zh: 古老森林最悠久的小径旁，藏着这位灯笼般的小小奇迹。

91073.en: A winter-colored fairy from stories told beside the snowfield hearths.
91073.zh: 冬日色彩的仙灵，来自雪原炉火旁流传的故事。

91074.en: Its oversized eyes give this plains visitor an air of permanent astonishment.
91074.zh: 夸张的大眼睛，让这位平原访客看上去永远满是惊讶。

91075.en: A meadow wanderer that always seems to have forgotten where it was going.
91075.zh: 草甸上的漫游者，总像是忘记了自己原本要去哪里。

91076.en: A bright little detail in the shadow forest's long, mysterious evenings.
91076.zh: 阴影森林漫长而神秘的夜晚中，一点明亮的小小身影。

91077.en: Its iron-colored body looks oddly at home among the abandoned desert workings.
91077.zh: 铁色的身体，在废弃的沙漠工地之间显得意外地相衬。

91078.en: The palm groves have their own strange visitors, and this one rarely goes unnoticed.
91078.zh: 棕榈林里不乏奇怪访客，而它总是让人很难忽视。

91079.en: A small ghost from the stories whispered around the lifeless desert's empty camps.
91079.zh: 一个小小的幽灵，来自荒凉沙漠空营地旁低声讲述的故事。

91080.en: The mask hides a mystery that desert storytellers are happy to embellish.
91080.zh: 面具背后藏着的谜团，是沙漠说书人最乐于添枝加叶的话题。

91081.en: A spectral traveler whose pirate trappings suggest a voyage that never quite ended.
91081.zh: 一位幽灵旅者，海盗装束仿佛诉说着一场始终没有结束的航程。

91082.en: An iron-shaped relic of an older age, out of place yet unforgettable in the frozen north.
91082.zh: 旧时代留下的钢铁身影，在冰封北境中显得突兀，却让人难以忘怀。

91083.en: The ancient forest seems to have gathered its oldest branches into one wandering shape.
91083.zh: 古老森林仿佛把最年迈的枝干，聚成了一个漫游的身影。

91084.en: Its floral colors have inspired many arguments about where the garden ends and the creature begins.
91084.zh: 花朵般的色彩，让人分不清花园在哪里结束，生灵又从哪里开始。

91085.en: A familiar green silhouette among the long stems of the vast forest.
91085.zh: 广阔森林的修长草茎间，一道熟悉的绿色轮廓。

91086.en: A strange bloom from the damp corners of the ancient forest, beloved by eccentric botanists.
91086.zh: 来自古老森林潮湿角落的奇异花朵，深受古怪植物学家的喜爱。

91087.en: Its vivid red form stands out like an unwritten warning in the ancient undergrowth.
91087.zh: 鲜红的身形，在古老林下如同一则尚未写下的警示。

91088.en: A prickly-looking resident of the forest's tangled and seldom-traveled paths.
91088.zh: 古老森林纠结而罕有人迹的小径上，住着这位模样带刺的居民。

91089.en: Purple against the desert ochre, this scorpion is a striking subject for caravan tales.
91089.zh: 紫色与荒漠赭黄相映，让这只蝎子成了商队故事中醒目的主角。

91090.en: Its stone-like shape belongs among the weathered monuments of the arid desert.
91090.zh: 岩石般的外形，仿佛本就属于干旱沙漠中那些风蚀的古迹。

91091.en: A forgotten soldier in a white landscape, carrying the memory of a vanished regiment.
91091.zh: 白色大地上一名被遗忘的士兵，带着一支消逝军团的记忆。

91092.en: The high snowfields remember the banners that once followed this forgotten commander.
91092.zh: 高地雪原仍记得，那些曾追随这位遗忘统帅的旗帜。

91093.en: An old warrior from the north's longest tales, where winter outlives every kingdom.
91093.zh: 北境漫长传说中的古老战士，在那里，寒冬比每个王国都更长久。

91094.en: Its wintry appearance recalls the delicate patterns along a frozen woodland path.
91094.zh: 冬日般的外观，让人想起冰封林间小径旁那些精巧的纹样。

91095.en: A red mark among the shadow forest's roots, memorable even to seasoned scouts.
91095.zh: 阴影森林根系间的一抹红色，连老练斥候也过目难忘。

91096.en: Its ominous name features in countless campfire warnings along the shadow forest roads.
91096.zh: 沿着阴影森林的道路，它不祥的名字出现在无数营火旁的告诫中。

91097.en: The abandoned outposts have many strange boxes, but not all of them stay where they are left.
91097.zh: 废弃哨站里有许多奇怪的箱子，却并非每一只都会留在原地。

91098.en: A candle-shaped traveler from the desert's deserted halls and half-remembered ceremonies.
91098.zh: 蜡烛般的旅者，来自荒漠荒废的厅堂与记忆模糊的仪式。

91099.en: A walking piece of the mushroom groves, as curious as the forest that raised it.
91099.zh: 蘑菇林中会行走的一小部分，和孕育它的森林一样充满好奇。

91100.en: An old forest stump with an unexpected interest in the world beyond its clearing.
91100.zh: 一截古老的树桩，对林间空地之外的世界产生了意想不到的兴趣。

enemyGuide.fallbackRanged.en: Attacks targets within range with a projectile.
enemyGuide.fallbackRanged.zh: 发射投射物攻击射程内的目标。

enemyGuide.fallbackBuffer.en: Supports nearby monsters with an attack-speed boost.
enemyGuide.fallbackBuffer.zh: 提升附近怪物的攻击速度。

enemyGuide.fallbackHealer.zh: 恢复附近怪物的生命值。
